name: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
desc: If you would Special Summon a monster(s), except during the Damage Step (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; negate that Special Summon, then if this effect was activated using a card that was sent to the GY to activate its effect, banish that card. You can only use this effect of "Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring" once per turn.
